_about: Reviewed reclassifications applied by harness/finalize.mjs on top of the harness verdicts in registry/results/*.json. The harness verdict is kept as `harnessStatus`; every entry states why.

AUTH-012.reason: Product owner decision UPD-1, recorded 2026-10-21: "log out of all devices" is not needed for V1. No logout-all route exists (SessionService.revokeAllForUser is unused); single-session logout (AUTH-011) and server-side revocation on disable, removal and suspension are covered elsewhere. Revisit for a later release.

BUG-NEW-010 warmed car page survives dea.reason: Superseded by BUG-NEW-010-timing, which measures the same out-of-band suspension instead of sampling once at 65 s: the car page stops serving the car after 71 s and the dealer page after 332 s, inside the design of #251. The 65 s sample is shorter than the page's 60 s ISR window plus one regeneration.

NOTIFY-001.reason: Strengthened by NOTIFY-DISC-001: the console mailer emitted 274 dealer.application.received e-mails during the campaign; the outbox → worker path is asynchronous (PERF-DISC-001).

BUG-NEW-010-timing.reason: Out-of-band suspension (no console action): designed cache windows are ≈ 70 s (car, revalidate 60) and ≈ 610 s (dealer, revalidate 600); BUG-111 records the window.

_release: Release-candidate certification of 115ac26a (2026-10-30): triage entries that pointed at BUG-101, BUG-102 and BUG-109 were removed because those defects are fixed (#337, #340, #339) and the scenarios now PASS on the harness verdict; ENQ-LIFE-010's BLOCKED entry was removed because UPD-2 (#338) defined the transitions and v01-final-retest proves every backward move is refused.
